A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''guard''' of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] was wounded during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. He was wounded after the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Capture of Theed/Legends|entered]] the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the capital of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. He and another guard took cover from the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s in the gardens near the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]].

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] met this guard when the Jedi was trying to enter Theed. Kenobi talked to this guard, and asked for the codes to enter the area near the Palace. The guard gave Kenobi the code: J-154. The three were then attacked by more battle droids, but Kenobi destroyed the attackers and continued his mission.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Unidentified_wounded_Naboo_guard_1a.png|thumb|220px|Two guards and Obi-Wan]]
This guard appears in the [[1999]] [[Star Wars video games|adaptation]] of the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Episode I'']] movie. The player, taking the role of Kenobi, may meet this guard during the course of the game's fifth mission. The player can talk to the guard using several dialogue options and can also choose to ignore the guard. If the player chooses the latter option, he can talk to another guard, who will open the door. This article assumes the player chose to talk to the guard. In the credits, [[Greg Burson]] is listed as voicing "Injured Soldier #1" while [[Nick Jameson]] is listed as voicing "Injured Soldier #2." It is unclear who voices this character. The guard and [[Unidentified wounded Naboo guard 3|another guard]] have an entry in the characters overview in the start of the game's [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]].
